biggest_catch: The card arrives only after 90 days of good standing on a 1 Gig+ plan with autopay/paperless — it is value offsetting an internet subscription, not income; and anyone who took an Optimum card promo in the past 12 months is excluded.
catches: Account must stay in good standing (no past-due or returned payment) for the first 90 days after activation.
Virtual card delivered after the 90-day period (physical card mailed 4–6 weeks if elected) — not instant.
Requires enrollment in Paperless Bill and Auto Pay via bank account.
Cannot be used to pay the Optimum monthly bill; no cash or ATM access.
Not available if you participated in an Optimum Prepaid/Gift Card or Snappy Gift promotion within the past 12 months.
New residential customers only; not in all areas; former seasonal customers or those not in good standing are not eligible.

steps: Order 1 Gig Optimum Fiber Internet (or faster) as a new residential customer online.
Enroll in Paperless Bill and Auto Pay with a bank account and keep both.
Maintain the promotion and keep the account in good standing (no past-due or returned payments) for the first 90 days after activation.
Receive the $50 Visa prepaid card virtually after the 90-day period, or elect a physical card (mailed 4–6 weeks after).
timing: One-time; card delivered virtually after 90 days of good-standing service.
when_cash_arrives: One-time; card delivered virtually after 90 days of good-standing service.
maximize: Fastest honest path: One-time; card delivered virtually after 90 days of good-standing service. Structural blocker: telecom promos require an active-service waiting period (30-90 days of good standing) and pay as bill credits, prepaid cards, or long-term credit spreads per provider terms; nothing you do at signup shortens the waiting period.
